category.name: Find And Replace
category.preferred_workflow: Create a realistic sample document (DOC, DOCX, HTML, TXT, stream, or folder) locally, configure a FindReplaceOptions instance with the needed flags, and invoke Document.Range.Replace using either a literal string, a Regex, or a custom IReplacingCallback. After replacement, validate the returned count, optionally log the operation, and save the document in the desired format.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference System.Drawing; use Aspose.Drawing for any drawing-related types.
Do not assume source files or folders exist; always bootstrap them within the example.
Do not invent unsupported find-replace helpers such as Document.ReplaceAll or Paragraph.Replace.
Do not omit the final Save call when the task expects an output artifact.
canonical_patterns: Use Document.Range.Replace with a properly configured FindReplaceOptions or a Regex overload for all replacements.
Implement custom replacement logic by creating a class that implements IReplacingCallback and assigning it to FindReplaceOptions.ReplacingCallback.
Bootstrap local sample inputs (documents, streams, or folders) whenever a task references an existing source.
Employ Newtonsoft.Json for JSON reporting and reference Aspose.Drawing explicitly when drawing types are required.
nullable_warning_prevention: Initialize all non-nullable reference-type properties to avoid CS8618 warnings.
Guard any potentially null values before dereferencing to prevent CS8600, CS8602, and CS8604.
Declare locals as nullable when a null value is legitimate and perform explicit null checks before use.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0117 because properties such as MatchWholeWord, UseRegularExpressions, or FindWholeWords are not found on FindReplaceOptions.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references outdated or misspelled property names that do not exist in the current Aspose.Words API.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the correct property names: FindWholeWordsOnly, MatchCase, IgnoreFields, etc., as defined in Aspose.Words.Replacing.FindReplaceOptions.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words documentation for the exact property names and enable IntelliSense to catch misspellings.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0246 indicating that FindReplaceOptions cannot be found.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The required namespace Aspose.Words.Replacing is not imported, so the type is unavailable.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add `using Aspose.Words.Replacing;` at the top of the file.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always include the Replacing namespace whenever FindReplaceOptions or related types are used.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0246 because ReplaceEvaluator is undefined.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to use a non-existent delegate name; the correct interface is IReplacingCallback.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Implement IReplacingCallback and assign the instance to FindReplaceOptions.ReplacingCallback.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the Aspose.Words.Replacing namespace and use the documented IReplacingCallback interface for custom logic.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0103 or CS0246 when the code references the Field class without a proper using directive.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The Field class resides in Aspose.Words.Fields, which is not imported.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add `using Aspose.Words.Fields;` and reference Field members through that namespace.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Include the Fields namespace whenever field manipulation is required.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Improper source content for metacharacter replacement
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime throws InvalidOperationException because no line-break characters are found, resulting in zero replacements.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The sample document contains plain text without actual ControlChar.LineBreak or paragraph breaks, so metacharacter patterns never match.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Insert real line-break control characters (e.g., ControlChar.LineBreak) into the source document before performing the replace.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Validate that the document contains the expected control characters or use a regex that matches the actual content.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Invalid field handling when ignoring fields
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime throws InvalidOperationException indicating that a field code was unexpectedly modified.
common_failure_patterns.cause: FindReplaceOptions.IgnoreFields is set, but the replacement logic still attempts to modify field codes or the document contains only fields matching the search term.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Ensure that the search pattern does not target field codes, or verify that at least one non-field occurrence exists before replacement.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: When using IgnoreFields, design the find pattern to exclude field codes and always check the replacement count.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0029 because Aspose.Drawing.Color cannot be assigned to System.Drawing.Color.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code mixes types from the two drawing libraries, violating type compatibility.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use only Aspose.Drawing types (e.g., Aspose.Drawing.Color) and avoid referencing System.Drawing.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference Aspose.Drawing exclusively and qualify type names when ambiguity is possible.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1503 or CS1061 because constructors or methods such as DocumentBuilderOptions, InsertParagraphAfter, or ParagraphStyleName are not found.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to use non-existent overloads or members that belong to older versions of the API.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Instantiate DocumentBuilder with a Document instance and use supported methods like InsertParagraph, MoveTo, or ParagraphFormat properties.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Refer to the current Aspose.Words API reference for DocumentBuilder usage and rely on IntelliSense to select valid members.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Incorrect overload usage for regex replace
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1503 when a string is passed where a Regex is expected, or vice versa.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code calls the overload that expects a Regex object but supplies a plain string, or supplies a Regex but provides a FindReplaceOptions where a string is required.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the overload `Range.Replace(Regex pattern, string replacement, FindReplaceOptions options)` with a proper Regex instance.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Match the method signature exactly: provide a Regex object for the pattern and a string for the replacement.

narrative.overview: The Find and Replace category demonstrates how to perform robust text substitutions in Aspose.Words documents using the native Range.Replace API. Verified examples illustrate literal, whole-word, case-sensitive, regex, and callback-driven replacements with proper handling of fields, metacharacters, and dynamic content insertion.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding agent with concise guidance to implement reliable find-and-replace operations in Aspose.Words, covering the correct API usage, required namespaces, and common pitfalls to avoid compilation and runtime errors.
validation_priorities: Validate that Document.Range.Replace returns a replacement count greater than zero before proceeding to save or report.
maintenance_notes: Periodically verify the Aspose.Words version used in the project to ensure property names and method signatures have not changed.
